{{Otheruses|Needle}}
'''Needle Gloves''' were a type of [[Glove/Legends|glove]] worn by politicians and [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]<ref name="DA">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref>

Appearing like any other glove, when a specific hand gesture is made the glove deploys an ultra-thin needle that is essentially undetectable, allowing the wearer to deliver a single dose of [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]], anesthetic, or paralytic to a target.<ref name="DA" />
